title: Dynamicisf not starting
body:
Hi
I updated from 3.2 to 3.3 two days ago( uninstall 3.2 to then install 3.3 and imported setting), now I always get the message :
Returning to smb not enough data, and returning to profile sensitivity not enough data reason tdd miss, any idea why? 
I also tried to sync to nightscout and get data from there but it's still the same.
Thanks
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1736052945398.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18309200/AndroidAPS_LOG_1736052945398.log.zip)

comments.body:
Hi. To avoid this you should update, not uninstall and install.

Check Statistics page, do you have 7 days of TDD there? If not you need to do a full sync with NSClientV3. Make sure you enable required settings to download bolus-data.

If you aren't able to download data you can disable Dynamic Sensitivity in SMB plugin and activate it again when you got 7 days of TDD data.

i am using NSClientV1 ,
any reason to change to NSClientV3?
thanks.
@olorinmaia
If you got 7+ days of TDD V3 will be able to get that back with full sync. V1 only takes two days I think.

I checked again, started from clean install full sync with nightscout, but all of the nightscout data does not seems to be taken Into account, which is problematic , lats say your phone died instead of continuing with the new phone at the exact same condition you need to start over, if that can be fixed it will be amazing, thanks.

What data is missing? Basal/ TBR?

I think these two commits will improve this. Right now you need to enable all sync options in v3.

967384e8129431ba319366df26c24d519cafa447
380f5acf2e68786711f37708ac1a0d1562db4235

@MilosKozak I think, but not 100% sure that you need to enable the setting hidden behind engineering mode to get TBR data with full sync with AAPS? With AAPSClient all is good.

It seems like I am getting the full data since in the statistics I can see data from 30 days ago, but when I look in the log or in the smb window I see tdd24h=null all of those are null
@olorinmaia

That sounds strange indeed. Can you provide a screenshot of SMB plugin log and Statistics for TDD + logs? 

I see from your earlier logs that you only missed 7days tdd.
`20:19:46.007 [DefaultDispatcher-worker-6] D/CONSTRAINTS: [ConstraintObject.set():28]: Setting value false -> true (tdd1D=24.349999999999998 tdd7D=null tddLast4H=4.158333333333333 tddLast8to4H=4.766666666666666 tddLast24H=21.929166666666674)[ConstraintObject]`

If you are comfortable with it, try the following.
1) Check NSClientV3 settings that all sync options are enabled to download bolus, carbs, etc. (just to be sure, you can disable what you don't need after)
2) Maintenance > Export settings (In case of trouble)
3) Maintenance > Reset databases
4) Exit AAPS
5) Start AAPS
6) Do a full sync with NSClientV3

I just did this on my test-rig, and recovered all TDD-data, carbs, tbr etc.

Yes!!! 
Turning everything on when syncing did the trick , thank you so much for your help @olorinmaia
